name: Open into Wonder — "X target creatures … those creatures gain" reaches the X creatures picked
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). "X target creatures can't be blocked this turn. Until end of turn, those creatures gain \"Whenever this creature deals combat damage to a player, draw a card.\"" produced nothing: with X replaced by its value the antecedent read "2 target creatures", a count neither _resolveTheyPronoun nor extractTargetInfo knew (a digit count fell through to a board-wide filter), and the antecedent phrase ran on into its own verb ("… can't be blocked this turn"). Both now read digit counts and the phrase stops at the verb. X = 2: the two creatures picked have the ability, the third does not.
